errors.description: The verification difficulty sequence falls from 5 to 1 and the sheet is not declared as a drill.

critical_observations: All composition values, inverse formulas, domain restrictions, and manual diagnoses agree with independent recomputation.
artifact_findings: manual rubric (id 2): "Part (b): a correct response says the two rules were applied in the wrong order -- the inner rule g must act on the input first, and only then does f act on that output. Full credit names which rule was used first (f) and which should have been (g), or equivalently says that the value -2 is g(f(6)) rather than f(g(6)). Saying only 'arithmetic mistake' or 'wrong answer' earns no credit."
grader decision: award full credit only when the response identifies the reversed function order and names the required inner function.
v2 standards check: the blind packet contains no standards-map.md, so curriculum_alignment is capped at 3 rather than awarded 4.
Every rendered page of the worksheet, answer key, and study guide was inspected at normal reading size; every composition, inverse, and domain result was independently recomputed.
rationale: The official packet is correct, complete, and pedagogically useful. The v2 shadow rejects because the transcribed difficulty sequence is falling on a non-drill worksheet.
